[[Nihil's Daggers]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by a [[Fury Titan]] in [[The Foundry of Failed Creations]], a subsection of the [[Domain of Anguish]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Energy]] +5
:Energy gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a close technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following sets of [[dagger]]s:
**[[Asuran Daggers]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Daggers]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Norn Daggers]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Split Chakrams]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Daggers]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Tengu Daggers]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Zealous]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription|I have the power!]]" inscription


For daggers with the same stats that inflict [[Piercing damage]],
*Use one of the following sets of daggers with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]] and [[Dagger Handle]]:

OR
*Use one of the following sets of daggers with the appropriate [[Dagger Tang]], [[Dagger Handle]], and [[Inscription]]:

==Notes==
* Only a specific [[Fury Titan]] can drop these daggers. This [[titan]] is found in the fourth chamber of the [[The Foundry of Failed Creations|Foundry]], and is much larger than regular Fury Titans.
* Nihil means "nothing" in Latin, making these Nothing's Daggers in English.
